## Project Context checklist

- [ ] Architecture changed? → ADR + ADR registry
- [ ] Planning state changed? → `projects.toml`
- [ ] Scientific result changed? → immutable result / appropriate ledger
- [ ] Dataset authority changed? → dataset registry once it exists
- [ ] Generated view refreshed? → `project_context render`
- [ ] QntyAgentEval applicability? → MATCH / NO_MATCH / NOT_APPLICABLE

This checklist is guidance only; CI is the mechanical gate.
